links.outcome: Exact four-class pressure injury staging accuracy of zero-shot multimodal LLMs on public photographs
links.effect: Best exact four-class accuracy was 65.08% (GPT-5.2 structured JSON); Stage IV recall for GPT-5.2-pro was 8.79% (false-negative rate 91.21%).
links.quote: Stage IV undercalling remained safety-relevant; GPT-5.2-pro had Stage IV recall 8.79% and false-negative rate 91.21%.
